motivational_lines: “So truly where there is hardship there is also ease.” — Surah Ash-Sharh 94:5
“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” — Surah Ghafir 40:60
“And He found you lost and guided you.” — Surah Ad-Duha 93:7
“Do not lose hope, nor be sad.” — Surah Ali 'Imran 3:139
“Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286
“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” — Surah At-Talaq 65:3
“Indeed, My Lord is near and responsive.” — Surah Hud 11:61
“If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.” — Surah Ibrahim 14:7
“And seek help through patience and prayer.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:45
“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest.” — Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:28
“My mercy encompasses all things.” — Surah Al-A'raf 7:156
“And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.” — Surah Taha 20:114
“So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth.” — Surah Ar-Rum 30:60
“Allah is with the patient.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:153
“And put your trust in Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.” — Surah Al-Ahzab 33:3
“Is not Allah sufficient for His servant?” — Surah Az-Zumar 39:36
“And speak to people good words.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:83
“He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows whatever you conceal and whatever you declare.” — Surah At-Taghabun 64:4
“Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.” — Surah An-Nahl 16:128
“And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.” — Surah Ad-Duha 93:5
“Indeed, with hardship comes ease.” — Surah Ash-Sharh 94:6
“Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us.” — Surah At-Tawbah 9:51
“And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:195
“Patience is most fitting.” — Surah Yusuf 12:18
“Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.” — Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:11
“And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.” — Surah Ali 'Imran 3:103
“He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms.” — Surah At-Taghabun 64:3
“And He is with you wherever you are.” — Surah Al-Hadid 57:4
“Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.” — Surah Al-A'raf 7:56
“So remember Me; I will remember you.” — Surah Al-Baqarah 2:152
“And Allah is the best of providers.” — Surah Al-Jumu'ah 62:11
“Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.” — Surah Al-Furqan 25:74
“And He provides for him from where he does not expect.” — Surah At-Talaq 65:3
“Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.” — Surah Az-Zumar 39:53
“Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.” — Surah Ibrahim 14:39
“And walk not on the earth with insolence.” — Surah Al-Isra 17:37
“Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.” — Surah Al-Qadr 97:5
“And your Lord is Most Generous.” — Surah Al-'Alaq 96:3
“Allah wishes to lighten for you your burdens.” — Surah An-Nisa 4:28
“And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say: My Lord, have mercy upon them.” — Surah Al-Isra 17:24
“And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.” — Surah At-Talaq 65:2
“And He gives you of all that you ask for.” — Surah Ibrahim 14:34
“So flee to Allah.” — Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:50
“And Allah is forgiving and merciful.” — Surah An-Nur 24:22
“Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth.” — Surah Fatir 35:5
“My success is not but through Allah.” — Surah Hud 11:88
“And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses.” — Surah Al-Qasas 28:68
“And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.” — Surah Al-Buruj 85:14
“And say: Truth has come, and falsehood has departed.” — Surah Al-Isra 17:81
“So be patient over what they say and exalt with praise of your Lord.” — Surah Taha 20:130
